messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 Pager — Canary error rate exceeded threshold in eu-west (5xx spike). Alerting oncall.
Jordan: seeing ~18% 5xx on canary nodes serving eu-west traffic. spike started ~2m ago. traces show `kv-cache` errors and grpc timeouts.
Maya: confirmed. dashboards -> request_p50 220ms, p95 980ms, errors 18%. Is this a model runtime OOM or infra?
Jordan: logs from one pod: 
```
E 10:12:03 model-infer: KVCacheMiss error: rpc: deadline exceeded
E 10:12:04 grpc: connection error: EOF
E 10:12:05 oom-kernel: killed process 2431 (inference)
```
Jordan: multiple restarts in the canary replica set.
Sam: @Jordan @Maya do we know if this correlates with the new quant kernel switch we rolled 7m ago?
Lina: yes, the deploy included kernel v2-quant for gptx-small on canary. I can flip the feature flag for the kernel at the infra layer if we want a quick isolate.
Jordan: prefer kill-switch for the kernel flag (targeted) rather than full rollback if it's isolated. quick test: drop one canary to baseline kernel and see error rate.
Maya: we should isolate to eu-west canary only. Sam, can you confirm routing/ff propagation is scoped?
Sam: propagation looks scoped, but I see an inconsistent propagation marker for 3 of 6 canaries. likely race during rollout. Not global but enough to cause partial degradation.
Lina: executing kill-switch now: 
```
# disable quant-kernel for eu-west canary
ffctl set kernel_quant_v2 false --env eu-west --target canary --reason "5xx spike" --author lina
```
Lina: done. API returned 200, change pushed to control plane. waiting for pods to pick up.
deploy-bot: Feature flag update applied: kernel_quant_v2=false (eu-west canary). Rolling update triggered for 3/6 canary pods.
Jordan: pods are restarting, logs show kernel fallback messages. monitoring error rate…
Maya: error rate down to 5% after ~45s, p95 now 320ms. still above baseline but trending down.
Alex-CS: FYI, CS reported a few high-touch customers saw timeouts in the last 10 minutes. One ticket (CUST-1428) noted 503s on embeddings endpoint.
Jordan: thanks @Alex-CS. I'm opening a quick incident summary for CSMs and marking impacted customers list.
Sam: I'd still like a rollback of the quant-kernel release for the full canary next deploy if we confirm it's the root cause. we can promote kernel v2 later after additional tests.
Lina: creating rollback patch for the quant kernel release to revert canary artifact pin. Patch queued.
Oncall Rotation: I'm taking the handoff — summary: canary partial propagation of kernel_quant_v2 caused 5xx spike in eu-west canary; kill-switch flipped by Lina reduced errors to ~5%; ongoing work: rollback artifact and follow-up postmortem. handing to night oncall in 30m.
Maya: adding short live notes: impact window 10:12–10:14 primary, mitigated 10:13–10:15 after kill-switch. RCA hypothesis: race in flag propagation + kernel memory regression.
Jordan: next steps: 1) finish rollback patch and ensure no leftover config flags, 2) run a small repro to validate memory regression, 3) notify customers impacted and update CS. I'll own step 2. Lina please own step 1. Sam own config propagation check and add instrumentation to flag ctl.
Alex-CS: will coordinate with impacted accounts and send an update once rollback is confirmed.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-392345 (canary-kernel-degradation). Priority: P2. Add updates to the incident doc: /incidents/INC-392345.
Oncall Rotation: handing off to @Sam for overnight monitoring. I'll be available for 30m for questions. :wave:
